2.31.0: Align is now in the quick tools bar — Left / Center / Right / Top / Middle / Bottom as small icon buttons, on every tab. Reference auto-follows your selection: one layer aligns to the composition, two or more align to each other.
2.30.9: The library "couldn't reach" message now shows the exact underlying error, to pinpoint why Firestore can't be reached
2.30.8: Fixed clients appearing to vanish — a momentary connection hiccup could cache an empty library. It now never caches a failed load, retries automatically, and shows a Retry option instead of a false “No clients yet”. Your data was always safe.
2.30.7: Toolkit tools now expand and collapse with a smooth height animation on hover instead of snapping open
2.30.6: Toolkit tools are now reorderable too — drag a tool's header up or down to arrange them, and the order is remembered
2.30.5: You can now reorder the sidebar tools — drag a tool up or down in the left rail to put your most-used ones on top. Your order is remembered.
2.30.4: Slimmer side navigation — the left rail is now thinner and more compact, leaving more room for the tools when the panel is docked vertically on the side
2.30.3: Toolkit tools are now compact single rows that expand on hover — collapsed by default to save space, hover a tool to use it, move away and it tucks back. Search still opens matching tools.
2.30.2: Toolkit tools are now all expanded by default — no clicking to open each one (search still filters; click a header to collapse one if you want)
Fixed the quick-bar settings icon — it's a proper gear now instead of looking like a brightness icon
2.30.1: Library section headers (Colors / Styles / FX / Assets) now scroll with the list instead of staying pinned to the top

Library no longer reloads on every navigation — the client list and each client's items are fetched once and cached; opening a client, going Back, re-opening, and searching all use the cache. It refreshes automatically when you add/edit/delete
2.30.0: Quick animation bar (Fade / Slide / Scale / Null / Trim + settings) is now pinned to the top on every tab — always one click away no matter which tool you're in
Colors are even smaller now — tighter swatches packed more per row
2.29.1: Colors are now small swatches packed several per row (name + hex underneath) instead of big cards — takes up far less space
2.29.0: Style Library: Colors, Styles, FX and Assets now show all at once in one scroll, each under its own labelled divider with a count — no more switching tabs to see everything
Each section header has its own “+ add” buttons (Capture / Color / FFX / Asset), so you add straight into the right category
Sort applies across all sections; right-click / long-press still favourite, edit or delete an item in place
2.28.1: Auto Captions & Caption Importer: the steps are now numbered (1 File → 2 Text Style → 3 Settings) so the flow is obvious at a glance
Auto Captions: dropped the redundant second status line — all feedback now shows in one place
2.28.0: New navigation — a clean left icon rail replaces the top tabs, hub screen and split/dock system. One tap jumps to any tool (Library, Toolkit, Text Anim, Captions, Auto Cap, Smoooth); the active tool is highlighted and remembered between sessions
Removed the split-screen / docking system entirely for a simpler, less confusing layout — one tool fills the panel at a time
The whole panel now feels more consistent and accessible, especially in a small window
2.27.14: Anchor Point: added a diagnostic readout — the status bar now shows which cell you clicked and what the host received/computed, to pin down the misrouting
2.27.13: Anchor Point: each cell's dot now sits where its anchor is, so the 3×3 reads as a proper picker — and it confirms the grid is laid out correctly (the earlier "wrong side" clicks were the cells overlapping when the grid collapsed)
2.27.12: Anchor Point: fixed the 3×3 grid so all 9 cells are properly sized and clickable (some cells had a collapsed hit-area before, so only a few positions responded)
2.27.11: Trim Paths (Trim On / Trim Off) moved into the quick tools bar alongside Fade / Slide / Scale / Null
Anchor Point: fixed so it holds the layer in place on scaled AND rotated layers (rotation is now compensated), so it works correctly on every layer
2.27.10: Updater: downloads now retry (up to 4×) and validate each file before writing, so a momentary network/CDN hiccup no longer leaves a "partially failed" update — plus a one-click Retry button if a file still doesn't come through
2.27.9: New Anchor Point tool — a 3×3 grid in the Toolkit that snaps the selected layers' anchor to any of the 9 positions (corners, edges, centre) based on each layer's own bounds, without moving the layer on screen
New Trim Paths tool — Trim On draws a shape layer's stroke in at the layer start, Trim Off draws it out at the end (uses the quick-anim duration & ease)
2.27.8: Quick animations: added a "Fade style" setting — Keyframes (default) drops visible fade keyframes on the timeline like before; Linked keeps the expression-based fade that rides the layer's in/out points. Pick whichever you prefer in the Toolkit ⚙ settings
2.27.7: Quick animations: Fade In / Fade Out are now linked to the layer's length via an expression — the fade rides the layer's in/out points, so if you extend or trim the layer the fade automatically stays at the start/end (durations live in "Fade In"/"Fade Out" slider controls you can tweak)
2.27.6: Align & Distribute: the "Align to" default now follows your selection — one layer selected defaults to Composition, two or more defaults to Selection (you can still override it manually)
2.27.5: Align & Distribute: new "Align to" option — Selection (default) aligns the selected layers relative to each other, Composition aligns them to the comp frame like before
2.27.4: Toolkit quick animations: keyframes now land exactly the number of frames apart you set (snapped to whole frames, on the frame grid) — fixes the off keyframe distance
2.27.3: Add Null: the null now keeps After Effects' own default Null-Object label colour (from Preferences → Labels) instead of being overridden — matches whatever you've set (e.g. orange)
2.27.2: Add Null: the null's timeline bar is now trimmed to the selected layers' span (starts at the earliest in-point, ends at the latest out-point) instead of the whole comp; keeps the matching label colour, sits above the topmost selected layer, and no longer changes your layers' scale
2.27.1: Add Null: the null now matches the selected layers' AE label colour, sits directly above the topmost selected layer, and is sized to the biggest selected layer (layers keep their exact look — their scale is compensated so the sized null doesn't inflate them)
2.27.0: Style Library cleanup — removed the Fonts tab (a text style already saves its font and installs it on apply if missing) and the Anim tab; a client now holds just Colors, Styles, FX and Assets
New Text Animations tab — a shared library of animation presets (not tied to a client), searchable, with a hover preview (plays a preview clip if set, otherwise a motion mock)
Add animations with name + .ffx filename (+ optional preview clip on the assets release); click to apply to the selected text layer
2.26.0: Auto Captions: tidied the tab — the Hinglish explanation is now a hover “i” tooltip, and the set-once options (Vertical Offset, Fade, Group under Null) are tucked into a collapsible “Placement & styling” section, so the main view is clean and quick
2.25.0: Toolkit quick bar: clearer icons — eye (open/slashed) for Fade In/Out, magnifier +/− for Scale Up/Down — and each button now shows its name on hover
New Add Null button — drops a null centered on the selected layers and parents them to it
2.24.0: Toolkit: new always-on quick animation bar — one-click Fade In/Out, Slide Up/Down/Left/Right, Scale Up/Down on the selected layer(s)
In-animations (fade in, scale up, slides) snap to the layer's start; out-animations (fade out, scale down) end exactly on the layer's out point
A 30/70 ease is auto-applied to the keyframes; a settings gear lets you set duration, slide distance and the ease values
2.23.0: Toolkit is now an accordion — each tool collapses to a slim header row; click to expand (one open at a time), so all tools fit at a glance no matter how many there are
Added a search box at the top of the Toolkit to jump straight to any tool by name
2.22.0: Full visual revamp — cleaner, rounder, more premium: brand-blue palette with a subtle ambient gradient, softly floating rounded cards, and gradient blue buttons
Cohesive look across every tab, inspired by modern dashboard UIs
2.21.0: Auto Captions: new “Full transcript” button in the Review step — see the whole corrected transcript in one box, copy it with one click, or edit it there and sync the changes back to the captions
2.20.0: Auto Captions: upgraded the Roman-Urdu / cleanup AI — new default is GPT-OSS 120B (the old Llama model was deprecated by Groq)
Auto Captions: pick the model in Setup — GPT-OSS 120B, Kimi K2, Qwen3.6, or a lighter/faster option — so you can try a few and keep whichever reads best on your audio
2.19.0: UI refresh — unified color system (one cohesive dark palette + a single blue accent) so every panel feels like one product
Toolkit tool descriptions now tuck away and reveal on hover, so far more tools fit on screen
Consistent focus rings, hover states and shadows throughout; tighter labels and inputs for a cleaner, more professional feel
2.18.0: UI: tighter, cleaner layout across the board — smaller cards, panels, buttons and the Toolkit tools, so more fits on screen in a narrow panel
2.17.4: Auto Captions: English words now strictly stay in English (a hard rule) — even when Whisper wrote them in Urdu/Hindi script, they're restored to correct English spelling
Auto Captions: the Roman-Urdu pass now processes the WHOLE transcript in batches, so long videos no longer leave later lines un-romanized
2.17.3: Auto Captions: the Roman Urdu / Hinglish pass now follows a real house-style spelling guide — tou, keh, aap, nahi, bohut, aik, -ay endings, aa/oo/ee vowels, lowercase, minimal punctuation, English words kept in English
Much closer to hand-typed channel captions; you can still tweak any line in the Review step
2.17.2: Auto Captions: the Groq quota line now only shows the reset countdown when you're actually running low (the audio budget refills continuously, so the countdown was misleading when you're full)
2.17.1: Auto Captions: shows your live Groq quota — audio-seconds and requests left (with reset time) — read straight from Groq after each transcription, so editors can see how much they have before hitting the free-tier limit
2.17.0: Auto Captions: new Review & Edit step — after transcribing you see every caption in an editable list (with timecodes); fix any wrong words, then hit Create Captions for perfect results
No transcription model is flawless on Hinglish/Urdu, so this is the reliable way to 100% correct captions; turn it off with the 'Review & edit' checkbox if you want one-click creation
2.16.2: Auto Captions: fixed Hinglish sometimes coming out in Hindi/Urdu script — the romanizer now forces Latin-only output and automatically retries if any script slips through
2.16.1: Auto Captions: fixes garbled English words (e.g. “seve” → “save”, “kansistantli” → “consistently”) — the Hinglish pass now corrects mis-heard English using context, and a light auto-cleanup runs on non-Hinglish captions too
2.16.0: Auto Captions: moved the Groq API key into a clean Setup popup (⚙) so it no longer eats space in the tab
Auto Captions: one-click ffmpeg install — downloads a private copy just for DopeTool (no admin, survives updates); auto-used for compressing/extracting audio
Auto Captions: the tab now scrolls properly, and a Key/ffmpeg status is shown at a glance
2.15.3: Auto Captions: proper code-switched Hinglish — Hindi/Urdu words come out in Roman while English words stay in English (e.g. “mein chahta hun ke main paise invest karun consistently”)
Tick the Hinglish option and set Language to Auto or Hindi for mixed speech
2.15.2: Auto Captions: switched to the whisper-large-v3 model so Urdu/Hindi audio is transcribed in its own language instead of being translated to English
Auto Captions: added Urdu as its own language option (separate from Hindi) — pick your language for the most accurate result
Auto Captions: captions now hold until the next one starts, fixing flicker and off-feeling gaps between lines
2.15.1: Auto Captions: big files & videos are now auto-compressed to 16 kHz mono with ffmpeg before upload — fixes 'Request Entity Too Large' and lets you feed full video files
Auto Captions: live progress with elapsed seconds for each stage (preparing audio, transcribing, romanizing)
2.15.0: New Auto Captions tab — transcribe an audio/video file and turn it into styled, timed caption layers automatically
Powered by Groq (Whisper) — paste your own free Groq API key once (console.groq.com/keys); it's stored only on your machine
Set how many words go in each caption, pick any saved text style, and optionally romanize Hindi/Urdu to Hinglish / Roman Urdu
Drop the file or Browse; captions are created in the active comp using your existing caption styling (offset, fade, null group)
2.14.5: Docking: cleaner split divider — a subtle centered grip handle on a hairline that turns blue and widens when you hover it
2.14.4: Docking: the split divider is now a visible thin blue line (brightens on hover) so it's easy to find and drag
2.14.3: Smoooth: the Speed Graph now has draggable ease handles too — drag sideways for influence, up/down for velocity (mirrors the Value graph)
2.14.2: Smoooth: the built-in presets now sit above the graph editor
Smoooth: new Value Graph / Speed Graph toggle — see the velocity curve like AE's speed graph
Smoooth: every preset (built-in and your saved ones) now shows its name under the thumbnail
2.14.1: Split now drops the tab you're on into the bottom panel (the rest stay up top)
Switching tabs no longer reloads anything — each panel loads its data once and keeps its state (Library scroll, saved graph presets, etc.)
2.14.0: Reworked docking — two stacked panels: the main one on top, a second one you open below with the split button
Each panel has its own tab strip and can hold several tabs — use the + on a panel to pull another tab into it, so you can have two-up top and two-up bottom
A tab lives in exactly one panel: opening it below removes it from the top bar, and closing the split (×) sends its tabs back up
Drag a tab between the two strips to move or reorder it; the active tab stays highlighted and centered; drag the divider to resize
Your layout is remembered on your machine
2.13.2: Docking fixes: the active tab no longer disappears from the top bar — it stays and is highlighted; only tabs open in another pane leave the bar
Click a pane to focus it — the highlight and the top bar now follow the focused pane
Fixes the confusing empty / missing-tab top bar from 2.13.1
2.13.1: Docking: opening a tab in a pane now removes it from the top bar — the bar shows only the tabs that aren't in a pane yet, so there's no duplicate/forced 'main' tab
Mouse-wheel over the top bar now steps only through the tabs still in the bar
2.13.0: Free-form docking — drag a tab into a pane's edge to split it, arrange panes however you like
Resize panes by dragging the dividers, close a pane with ×, and reset to a single pane with the square button
Your dock layout is remembered on your machine
2.12.1: Split view: the two panes are now fully independent — changing one never affects the other, and a tab already open in one pane is greyed out in the other
Fixed the 'Add New Client' bar so it stays inside the Library pane
2.12.0: Split view — click the split icon (top right) to show two tabs at once, top and bottom
Pick any tab for the bottom pane, drag the divider to resize, and your split layout is remembered
2.11.1: Drag the top tabs to reorder them however you like — your order is remembered on your machine
2.11.0: Smoooth: save your own easing presets — shared with the whole team, shown in a My Presets panel on top of the graph
Smoooth: Start / End value boxes to type the handle influence directly (and they update as you drag)
2.10.3: Smoooth now applies correctly to Position (and all property types) — fixed a temporal-ease length mismatch — with clearer status messages
Mouse wheel over the tabs steps through them again, and the active tab centers itself
2.10.2: Fixed the Smoooth tab — it now scrolls to the presets, the drag handles work, and Apply reaches your keyframes
2.10.1: Top tabs no longer squish in a narrow panel — the tab bar scrolls sideways with edge fades, mouse-wheel scrolling, and the active tab auto-scrolls into view
2.10.0: New Smoooth tab — a live cubic-bezier keyframe easing editor
Drag the two handles to shape the curve, or click a preset, then Apply to your selected keyframes
12 built-in easing presets (gentle → snappy, ease in/out, linear)
2.9.0: New Toolkit tool — Slider Counter: adds a Counter slider to a text layer and links the text to it
Set a prefix ($) and postfix (KG, %), choose decimal places, and toggle thousands commas — keyframe the slider to animate the number
2.8.3: Toolkit redesign — each tool now has its own colored icon, title and accent stripe so they're easy to tell apart
2.8.2: Caption Importer: each caption's anchor point is now centered on its text (easier to scale/animate)
2.8.1: Text Exploder: fixed word/character positioning so pieces stay exactly where they were (now accounts for spaces and kerning)
2.8.0: Caption Importer: drag & drop your .srt straight onto the panel (Mac + Windows)
New Toolkit tool — Text Exploder: split a text layer by word / line / character
Exploded pieces get a centered anchor point and are stacked bottom-to-top, ready to stagger-animate
2.7.1: Add Asset now lists files straight from the GitHub release — pick from a dropdown, no typing filenames (name + type auto-fill)
Fixed scrolling so the last items in any tab are always reachable
Cleaner tab bar (icon over label) and tidier layout
2.7.0: New Assets tab per client — images, videos and .aep templates
Assets are hosted free on GitHub Releases (no repo bloat); click a card to download and drop it straight into your comp
Add assets with + Add Asset (name, type, filename) after dropping the file on the repo's 'assets' release
2.6.1: Fixed a harmless-but-scary 'Image is not a constructor' error by switching Firestore to long-polling (the transport that works inside After Effects)
2.6.0: Text styles now save AND re-apply layer styles (drop shadow, stroke, glows, color overlay) — no FFX needed for those
Caption Importer applies the style's layer styles too
Caption Importer now creates point text instead of box text
Note: Gradient Overlay colours still need an FFX (AE can't fully serialise gradients)
2.5.2: Bounce Amplitude now defaults to 20 for a subtler bounce out of the box
2.5.1: Wiggle & Bounce expressions now add adjustable Expression Controls to the layer (Amplitude, Frequency, Decay, Floor) so you can fine-tune them live in Effect Controls
2.5.0: New Toolkit tab — comp & layer utilities
Reframe Comp: switch the active comp to 9:16 / 1:1 / 16:9 / 4:5 with content auto-scaled (fit/fill/recenter)
Expressions: one-click Wiggle, Loop, Bounce (and Clear) on the selected property
Align to comp (left/center/right/top/middle/bottom) and distribute layers evenly
Tightened the Style Library logo spacing
2.4.2: New reload button (⟳) in the top bar — refresh the panel in place after an update instead of closing and reopening it
After an update, the banner now has a one-click Reload button
2.4.1: Caption Importer now applies the selected text style's effects (drop shadow, glow, etc.) to every caption, matching the Styles tab
2.4.0: Design refresh — cleaner cards, focus rings, tidier scrollbars
Colors now show as a compact swatch grid instead of a list
Add a color manually by typing a hex — no layer needed (+ Add Color)
Favorite any item (right-click → Favorite) to pin it to the top
Sort items A–Z or by most recent
2.3.6: Fixed font detection that always reported fonts as installed — auto font install now actually triggers on both Mac and Windows
Windows: downloaded fonts are now registered with the system so After Effects can see them (previously they installed silently but never appeared)
Installer now enables CEP debug mode for newer After Effects versions
2.3.5: Quick Capture now saves ALL effects on a layer, not just the first one
Fixed empty dead space at the bottom of the Style Library panel
2.3.4: Added persistent top tab bar — Style Library, Captions, Graph Tool
Style Library now opens by default instead of the old tool hub
Caption Importer now has client filter pills for faster navigation
Removed unused back buttons now that tabs handle navigation
